Small talk and jibber jabber about small animal (canine and feline) veterinary Emergency and Critical Care (ECC), largely with a first opinion focus, with Shailen Jasani MA VetMB MRCVS, Diplomate of the American College of Veterinary Emergency and Critical Care (DipACVECC).
